question.text: Two identical thin rods of mass $M \mathrm{~kg}$ and length $L \mathrm{~m}$ are connected as shown in figure. Moment of inertia of the combined rod system about an axis passing through point $P$ and perpendicular to the plane of the rods is $\frac{x}{12} \mathrm{ML}^{2} \mathrm{~kg} \mathrm{~m}^{2}$. The value of $x$ is $\_\_\_\_$.
